description: The MCP bridge, and nothing else. Split out of `default` because `execute-command` and `execute-js` are arbitrary-code primitives: the plugin is registered only under `cfg(debug_assertions)`, but a capability listed in `default` is compiled into the release ACL too, so the only thing standing between a release build and those commands would be the plugin not being registered. Two locks are better than one. This file is granted only by `tauri.dev.conf.json`, which `pnpm dev` passes and no bundle does.
